description:
• Theme: Your content should align with our mission of promoting vegan, cruelty-free, and plant-based skincare. Highlight how our products have improved your skincare routine or skin concerns like dry skin, hyperpigmentation, or aging.

• Platform: Content can be posted on TikTok, Instagram, or both. Please tag us in your posts:

• Instagram: @_Veganskincare

• TikTok: @glowwithpurposeskincare

• Hashtag: Use the campaign hashtag #GlowWithPurpose to make sure we see your post.

• Content Type: We encourage authentic, creative, and engaging content such as:

• Before-and-after photos or videos

• Skincare routines featuring Glow With Purpose products

• Testimonials, reviews, or transformations

• Educational posts about vegan skincare or our product ingredients


2. Content Rights:


By participating in this UGC campaign, you agree to grant Glow With Purpose LLC the rights to use your content in the following ways:


• Social Media: We may repost your content on our official social media accounts, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube.

• Marketing Materials: Your content may also be used in email newsletters, advertisements, or other marketing campaigns to showcase real customer results.

• Website: We may feature your content on our website (www.glowwithpurpose.com), especially in the customer testimonials or product results sections.

Welcome to Glow With Purpose!

Thanks for your interest in becoming a Glow With Purpose Ambassador! We're so excited to partner with content creators, influencers, and beauty lovers who believe in our mission and want to glow with us.

By participating in this program, you're agreeing to these terms — please read them carefully, and check the box at signup to provide your electronic signature.

📝 Full Ambassador Agreement
👉 Click here to review the full PDF agreement
(We recommend reviewing it before submitting your application.)

🔑 Key Terms (Simplified)

1. Approval
We reserve the right to accept or decline ambassador applications based on alignment with our brand. No hard feelings!

2. Tracking Links & Codes
You’ll receive a unique referral link and/or discount code. If someone clicks your link or uses your code at checkout, you’ll earn 10% commission on the sale. If both are used, only one tracks.

3. Commission & Payments
You earn 10% commission on successful orders. Payouts are monthly, based on verified sales (excluding taxes, refunds, or shipping). Make sure your payment details are up to date!

4. Sharing & Promotion
We encourage you to share Glow With Purpose authentically on Instagram, TikTok, blogs, and more. You’ll get access to images, content, and tools in your dashboard.

5. Cookie Tracking
We use cookies to track your referrals. If someone clears cookies or disables them, we may not be able to track that sale.

6. Leaving the Program
Want to leave? No worries — just email us at support@glowwithpurpose.com and we’ll take care of it.

✅ By submitting your application and checking the box, you confirm that:

  • You’ve read and understood the Ambassador Agreement

  • You agree to promote responsibly and honestly

  • Your checked box serves as your electronic signature

Let’s glow and grow together! 💫
